draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the getting-started call last week. Picking up where we left off: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so creating your first one is the quickest way to see how it fits Timber Collective. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

If it's easier, I'm glad to walk through setting up that first project with you on a short call this week 
come prepared with nothing.

Best,
Priya
